name: Music coach
annotation: HIFI-80 · /soundscape · dark shell, glow-you orange on player hero card

modules.build: Standard iOS status bar, dark mode, white icons on #0A0A0F.

GlassCard.hero r40 glow-you #FF5E00; overline 'NOW PLAYING'; image tile 'HIFI-80-01'; title 'Tempo run focus'; subtitle 'CIA matched to your planned *pace* window'; WaveformMomentumBar at 62%; time '1:58' / '3:12'; controls: pause, next
row1: ChipDomainTag purple 'CIA matched', ChipProvenance green 'Workout ready'; row2: ChipProvenance 'via Spotify', ChipProvenance 'cached 2m ago'
CIAInsightCard: toggles summary 'Uses: workout on · mood off'; insight 'CIA: 154-158 BPM fits today's run.'
section overline 'RECOMMENDED PLAYLISTS'; list rows solid #211008 r16: 'Tempo run focus' tag '156 BPM'; 'Deep work pulse' tag 'low lyric'; 'Evening downshift' tag 'breath-led'
BtnSecondary solid #211008 full-width: icon headphones, text 'Connect Spotify'
Floating nav pill: Today · CIA · Goals · Me, 44px targets; standard iOS home indicator docked beneath it, overlaying the bottom edge of provider_cta per canon floating-nav behavior.

trustControls: OAuth sheet names scopes, sync frequency, retention, revoke, disconnect, export, and delete provider cache
Recommendation settings expose per-signal toggles for mood, recovery, workout, listening history, and calendar context
Copy: 'Listening history is not shared with Spotify beyond what the provider requires to play and manage your library.'
Listening history is not shared to social surfaces unless the user explicitly attaches it
Provider chips open Manage devices/Data Sources
notes: UI may use 'Pulse' as product label only if confirmed by product copy; route header remains '/soundscape' (per spec Implementation Notes).
WaveformMomentumBar is a continuous progress primitive with subtle waveform texture — the spec's one NEW component for this screen.

Fixed against draft: draft had 9 modules (exceeds the 8-module cap) with nav_pill/home_indicator split in two — merged into a single GlassNavBar module matching the pattern used elsewhere (e.g. HIFI-22, HIFI-17). Draft also had provider_cta at y=688 overlapping recommended_playlists (608-736); moved provider_cta to y=744. GlassNavBar (756-844) intentionally overlaps the tail of provider_cta as a fixed floating-overlay bottom nav, not a layout bug. No copy, shell, italic-word, chip, or trust-control errors found — those all matched source spec exactly.
